'''Team USA''' is the United States squad in the Players Committee [[Outrider Cup]] series, the biennial Europe versus United States team event on GEMP. The side has won three of the four Cups: [[2019 Outrider Cup]], [[2023 Outrider Cup III]], and [[2026 Outrider Cup IV]]. [[Team Europe]] won [[2021 Outrider Cup]] on a captains' tiebreaker.

Six players a side is the published format: Player of the Year points plus a captain's pick, unique objectives per team, and a race to seven. Captains have been [[Joe Olson]] (2019, 2021, 2026) and [[Justin Desai]] (2023).

The 2019 congratulations thread is titled '''Congratulations Team USA'''; Tom Damen's first post opened "Well done Murica!" The 2023 PC results page publishes the same six-player USA squad as '''Team North America'''. The 2026 information thread and live scoreboard also use North America in places; the pairings post and PC results page list United States / Team USA. This wiki uses '''Team USA''' as the encyclopedia label.

=== 2021 Outrider Cup ===

Captain [[Joe Olson]]. November 2021 – 26 January 2022. Runner-up after a 6–6 regulation series; Olson lost the 26 January 2022 captains' tiebreaker to [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]. Olson and [[Justin Desai]] went 2–0 in their two match-ups.<ref name="oc21">https://www.starwarsccg.org/team-europe-wins-the-2021-outrider-cup/</ref>
